current_goal: Return to Riverton with Ferol and Emric and report what was found.
key_facts: Both carved stones are back in the ring and the ring is whole; the dead rest again.
The dead figure spoke: the ring is whole, the dead sleep again, the cold stops drinking when the stones sit in their places, and what was drunk does not come back.
Ferol never took a stone; the cold got into her anyway just from being in the chamber.
A dead hunter on the ridge died of the same sickness (thin blue lines, no wounds) and carried a second carved stone, the same kind as Milo's.
Milo carries the first stone no longer; both stones are in the ring, neither is carried now.
Sylvie has the hunter's shortbow and a quiver with 10 arrows.
The party has 18 rations and 3 full waterskins plus a half-full one.
Level 3 is at 900 XP; the party is at 621, so 279 to go.
The carved stone is a keeper of the dead; it drinks warmth, which is the blue lines.
Verla Pelc is sick with the blue lines; the warming tonic holds but does not cure.
Ferol is the healer, Dain is the guard; they are not brothers.
There is no falling-star prophecy, no heartstone shard, no Crystal of Dawn, and no waking shards in this campaign.
The missing guide is named Emric; the party found him alive in a hollow in the hills east of the old road and brought him back to the road.
Emric's leg is hurt; he can move with help, but it still hurts and drags a little. Thin blue lines remain faint on his fingers.
Liora and Sylvie have both healed Emric; his swelling eased, his breathing steadied, and color came back to his face, but the thin blue lines remain faint on his fingers.
Emric left a marker: his walking staff snapped in two, the top half stuck upright with a strip of green cloth tied to it. Wolf prints circled beside the trail, and a smear of blood was on a rock.
Emric has been reunited with Dain and Ferol and travels south with the party.
The party broke camp and set out south on the old road toward Riverton with Dain, Ferol, and Emric; Dain leads, Bram walks with Emric, Milo walks with Ferol.

Milo spotted fresh wheel ruts turning off east toward a low rise; Sylvie spotted thin smoke beyond it. Dain knows the place: a small farmstead just off the road, the farmer keeps a cart and a sturdy horse. The wounded can rest by the track while the party goes up to ask.
